# Pantheon Observatory

> A cinematic cosmic operating system — a living archive of UAP cases, whistleblower testimony, ancient mythology, consciousness research, and disclosure. Includes Echo, an AI thinking partner, and a sitewide search across every dossier.

Pantheon Observatory ("Pantheon Frequency 46") is a curated, evidence-graded archive. Every dossier separates the verified record from the contested claims and lists primary sources. Realms include Disclosure / UAP, Cosmos, Consciousness, Mythology, Earth & Ancient, Echo AI, and the Observatory itself.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Temple Observatory — live solar weather, Earth + anomalous activity, the 12-god compass.
- [Search](/search): Sitewide search across every dossier, expert, and finding.
- [Echo AI](/echo): Conversational AI partner trained on the Pantheon archive.
- [The 46](/the-46): Vault of flagship drops, defiance modules, and skeptic spotlights.
- [Codex](/codex): Master index of realms and dossiers.

## Disclosure & UAP

- [UAP Cases](/uap): Verified UAP encounters — Nimitz, Gimbal, Aguadilla, and more.
- [Legislation Tracker](/legislation): U.S. UAP disclosure bills, NDAA amendments, AARO mandates, and congressional hearings, sourced to congress.gov and AARO.
- [Whistleblower Vault](/whistleblowers): Testimony archive with evidence grades and suspicious-death tracking.
- [AARO Watch](/aaro): Pentagon's All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office — filings, leadership, public record.
- [Crash Retrieval](/crash-retrieval): Alleged recovered craft and biologics — claim, counterweight, status.
- [Black Programs](/black-programs): Compartmentalized aerospace and SAP history.
- [Underground Bases](/underground): DUMBs and the verified vs. claimed record.
- [Entity Encounters](/encounters): Witness testimony of non-human intelligences.
- [Missing Scientists](/missing): Unexplained deaths in physics, biotech, and aerospace.
- [Orb Report](/orb-report): The orb phenomenon — sightings, footage, analysis.
- [Brazil Wave](/brazil): Operation Saucer, Colares, and the Brazilian UAP record.
- [Jeremy Corbell](/corbell): Investigative journalist dossier and releases.
- [Documentaries](/documentaries): Curated long-form films.
